# Dominican Republic Vacation Spots

> Dominican Republic Vacation Spots (dominicanrepublicvacationspots.com) is an independent, bilingual (English/Spanish) guide to vacation destinations in the Dominican Republic, from Punta Cana's beaches to Samaná's whale-watching bays, with a trip planner. It is not affiliated with any resort, tour operator or government tourism body.

## Pages
- [Home](https://dominicanrepublicvacationspots.com/): destinations, trip planner and advertiser information

## Editorial notes
Rankings are editorial. Prices, entry requirements, seasons and ocean conditions change; verify with current official sources.

## Primary authoritative source
https://www.godominicanrepublic.com/
